fem_needle_insertion.caption: Simulation-time playback: select entry and exit material points across a region 1 wound gap, preview the curved needle, then start, pause and resume coupled MuJoCo/FEM insertion through both tissue sections. Illustrative puncture and sliding-track forces; no fracture or physiological calibration. Playback rate does not measure live FPS.

fem_phantom_regions.caption: Click the 2D pad map to select a SutureBot wound: right-drag wound 4, switch to wound 6, disable FEM, then return to wound 4. Wound numbers follow the dataset; inactive material stays fixed.

fem_dvrk.caption: Replay measured da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) tissue3 tool motion with prepared USD tools, cameras, fixture and the original static phantom. Four synchronized views compare the model with source video; green point labels stay on the mesh. Camera and pad placement remain fitted estimates.

fem_phantom_cut.caption: The complete 413,405-tetrahedron pad rests on the floor. A finite slice separates an edge strip, which a physical spring grip lifts and releases. All material is active; no region selection. Simulation-time playback is not measured live FPS.

fem_versius.caption: Generated kinematic preview of two supplied CMR Versius distal needle holders above a static phantom, with two illustrative stereo views. The video panels contain unrelated dVRK placeholder footage, not measured Versius recordings or calibrated image alignment. Playback rate is not live FPS.

needle_thread.caption: Simulation-time playback: a spring hold lifts the free MuJoCo needle on its thread, whose far end is pinned to the floor, and lets it go. The needle and the thread act on each other; there is no tissue. Illustrative needle mass and thread stiffness. Playback rate does not measure live FPS.

fem_needle_suture.caption: Simulation-time playback: the MuJoCo needle makes three planned stitches across the region 1 wound and its thread follows through every track and lies on the pad with friction. The thread is then tied at the first entry and pulled until the tissue limit, which narrows the wound from 2.4 mm to about 1.2 mm, tied at the last exit, and the needle is let go. Blue and orange spheres mark where the thread enters and leaves the tissue. Illustrative forces; no calibration. Playback rate does not measure live FPS.
